name: 오딘
design: Elderly wise Norse father god, one visible piercing blue eye and a black eye patch over his other eye, square silver-white beard, silver hair, dark navy and rich gold raven helmet with two subtle black raven feathers, tiny gold forehead lightning rune. Stern but cute. No spear, torso or hands.

name: 토르
design: Friendly strong Norse thunder god, thick copper-red hair and short square red beard, bright blue eyes, silver and cobalt-blue winged helmet with gold accents and a small lightning-shaped forehead gem. A confident cute smile. No hammer, torso or hands.

name: 로키
design: Mischievous youthful Norse trickster god, emerald-green eyes, black chin-length hair, green and gold compact horned helmet with low curved gold horns kept close to the head silhouette, small emerald forehead jewel, playful smug little smile. No weapons, torso or hands.

name: 헬
design: Cute Norse underworld queen, one half of the face pale ivory with a normal teal eye and the other half subtle blue-gray with a tiny stylized skull-cheek motif and matching teal eye, shoulder-length half white/half dark hair, compact black and turquoise crown with gold edging and central aquamarine jewel. Keep the face sweet and non-gory. No torso or hands.

name: 수르트
design: Cute powerful fire giant, dark charcoal stone skin, golden-orange eyes, blocky short ember beard and fiery orange-red hair contained into a near-square silhouette, compact black iron crown with gold edges and an orange magma jewel. Fine glowing lava seams on stone cheeks, determined little mouth. No torso, weapons or hands.

name: 프레이
design: Gentle handsome youthful Norse sunlight god, sunny blond chin-length hair, bright green eyes, ivory and leaf-green compact circlet with rich gold ornament and a small sun-yellow jewel, two subtle leaf ornaments near the temples. Cute relaxed smile. No torso, weapons or hands.

name: 발드르
design: Radiant cute Norse god of light, pale peach face, platinum-blond square-cut hair, warm amber eyes, bright ivory helmet/circlet with rich gold sun-ray temple ornaments and a central glowing pearl jewel, small peaceful smile. No halo disc behind the head, no torso, weapons or hands.

name: 스카디
design: Cute female Norse winter huntress, icy white bob haircut with a pale blue tint, icy blue eyes, compact steel-blue helmet with silver and gold edging, white fur at temple edges and a snowflake-cut blue jewel at the forehead. Calm determined face. No antlers or large horns, no torso, weapons or hands.

name: 프레이야
design: Cute beautiful youthful Norse goddess of earth and radiance, warm strawberry-blond square-cut wavy bob, emerald-green eyes, rich gold compact floral crown with leaf-green inlay and a small amber jewel, a hint of elegant cat-ear-shaped ornaments integrated into the crown, friendly soft smile. No torso, weapons or hands.

name: 이미르
design: Cute ancient frost giant, pale blue stone skin, short square snow-white beard and white chunky hair, gray rocky brow crown with gold edging, icy cyan forehead crystal, deep blue eyes, tiny friendly stern mouth, subtle ice cracks in the stone cheek. No torso, weapons or hands.

name: 울르
design: Cute male Norse winter archer god, ash-blond square-cut hair and compact short ash-blond beard, green-blue eyes, muted slate-blue and gold helmet with white fur temple trim and tiny paired arrow-feather ornaments tucked close to the head, an icy green gem. No bow, torso or hands.

name: 브륀힐드
design: Noble cute Valkyrie commander distinct from the supplied fallen common Valkyrie: warm pale face, vivid sky-blue eyes, silver-white bob, brilliant ivory and rich gold winged helmet with ivory feather ornaments kept compact and a sapphire forehead gem, confident cheerful tiny smile, no fangs. No armor body, neck, weapons or hands.

name: 브록 & 에이트리
design: ONE synergy icon showing TWO cute dwarf brothers nestled side by side into ONE overall square head silhouette. Left brother copper-red beard, right brother pale-gray beard, both stout round-square faces with tiny bright eyes and compact purple and gold smith helmets with amber jewels. Heads occupy the top half and chunky beards the lower half so the combined silhouette is square. Exactly two dwarves, no bodies, weapons or hands.
